The paper contains the resutls of experimets of all algorythms with all preceses for text and all data.
It's concluded that the linear regresion is not very good.
The best is the two nearest neighbour.

Insightful findings in political science often require researchers to analyze documents of a certain subject or type, yet these documents are usually contained in large corpora that do not distinguish between pertinent and non-pertinent documents.
In contrast, we can find relevant documents in an appropriate large corpus, but we have not seen documents like ours before (from the target domain), we call this the "problem of domain shift".
A lot of the times the relevant documents (from the target domain) are not labeled, so we can't use the algorithm for learn on them.

In this paper, we present a solution to this problem by introducing a new algoritm, AdaEnsen, that learns first on the lot of the documents (the large corpus) to see what words are important (we call these features) and then learn with another lot of documents (that are not labeled and not like the first lot) to be able to know the features that we have to use in the first lot.

In the analysis of political documents we usually have a lot of documents but not all of them are good for our research, but all of them are in the same collection of documents (the source domain).
But our research are the documents that are in another collection (the target domain) and not all the documents in the target domain are good for us.
If there is no information from the target domain then we use a lot of the time all the document in the source domain (the features) and not only the good doc (the features of good doc).
This is a problem for learn well with few data (the doc of the tar dom).

sentences.sentence: A regioselective synthesis of new mono and bisoxindoles containing bis spiro heterocyclic hybrids has been envisaged via 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition of azomethine ylides with the corresponding diazo ester, obtained from a reaction of isatin with oxalylochloride.
Some of the spiro compounds have got also the embedded pharacophore of 4-amino-piperidine, thus they are potential monoamine re-uptake inhibitors.
The new spirooxindoles were submitted to biologic evaluation to evaluate the MAO-B inhibiting activity.
The 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition reaction between azomethine ylide and diazo ester gives a good yield of 62-98%, depending on the substitution of the isatin used in the reaction.
The structure of the spiro compounds was proved by MS and NMR.

sentences.sentence: The widespread availability of many emerging services enabled by the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm passes through the capability to provide long-range connectivity to a massive number of things, overcoming the well-known issues of ad-hoc, short-range networks.

This capability is also crucial in traditional wired and wireless networks, as it enables the support of many to many devices connected without manual intervention, to be connected simultaneously, in a wide variety of services and not just simple applications.
Title: On the Support of Massive Machine-to-Machine Traffic in Heterogeneous Networks and Fifth-Generation Cellular Networks
Abstract:

The growing demand for supporting many devices at the same time, with the same quality of service, that are connected to a base station and to each other, (it's the classic definition of the "Many to Many" problem of the computer science) is one of the biggest problems that the cellular networks need to solve.

To help to solve this problem we can use heterogeneous networks, which are formed by 5G cellular base stations and some fixed points that have many antennas, or just 5G cellular base stations, to use the best technology in every place.
To use this technology in the best way we need to look to the algorithms that we need to make the routing of the data, and to do this we must think about many things, like how the user is.
What is the position of this user.
How many devices has this user.
What is the position of these devices.
Which is the quality of the service that this user needs.
Which is the quality of the service that can give the network.
We can use a lot of technology to make this, but the one that is better is the one that uses only one thing: to do all the people to see the same things that the 5G cell want to see.
If we do this, all people can see in the same time, all that the cell can see.

sentences.sentence: This paper presents comparisons between predicted and measured data for a live GSM system.
Our propagation prediction software tool is based on 3D-ray tracing, and considers wave interactions, such as free space, reflection, diffraction, and scattering.
The underlying propagation model uses a grid of grid points, placed at a 1 meter interval, in a 20m * 20m square around the base station.
The measured data was done on one floor in a building.
The floor above and below the measurement floor was empty.
No people were present in the building during the measurement.
In the measurements, two antennas were used.
The first was on top of the building (6m from the floor), at 15m away from the base station and the second was on the ground at 4m from the base station.

We compared the predicted and measured data, and got  a good agreement between the RSSI values (Received Signal Strength)  for the first antenna, and for the 20 lowest power levels of the 2nd antenna.
The higher power levels of the 2nd antenna was lower then the predicted power level.

This was because these are the values when the signal is very strong and will not follow the radio-propagation rules in buildings, as there are not always walls between the cell and the base, so there will be a free path to the base.

"GHz third harmonic superconducting cavities have been used to increase the peak bunch current and to compensate for non-linear distortsions in the longitudinal phase space due to sinusoidal 1.3 GHz accelerating cavity voltage (1). The 3.9 GHz power coupler located after the third harmonic cavity is used to measure the energy lost by the bunch in the third harmonic cavity, so it can be a big limiting point in the linac because the 3.9 GHz power coupler has to be in very good thermal contact with the third harmonic cavity. That's why we have done some simulations and optimizations to this new 3.9-GHz power coupler for 3.9-GHz superconducting cavities at Fermilab.

Abstract

In this paper we present the simulations and the optimizations that we have done to a new power coupler for 3.9 GHz superconducting cavities at Fermilab. This power coupler can be used in a Linac to measure the energy lost by the bunch in the third harmanonic cavity. In this paper we also study the thermal contact between the third harmanonic cavity and the power coupler because the power coupler has to be in very good thermal contact with the third harmanonic caviy. We have done many simulations and optimizazions to the new power coupler that we put in our linac. We have tryed the power coupler that we have desingned with a "L" shape and also with a "U" shape. We have made the 3.9 GHz power couler with a copper and also with a aluminio.

In this work, we mainly investigate effect of PT-symmetric operation on the dynamic behavior of the relative entropy of coherence for a two-level system within non-Markovian environments and put forward a feasible physical scheme to recover cohe by utilizing optimal PT-symmetric operator.

We consider a two-level atom in a non-Markovian dissipation environment, where the reservoir correlation time  $\tau$ is large, the influence of the PT-symmetric operation on the coherence of the two-level atom is discussed.

sentences.sentence: Endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-associated degradation (ERAD) is a principal mechanism that targets ER-associated proteins for cytosolic proteasomal degradation.
Here, our data demonstrate a critical role for the ubiquitin-protein ligase complex Sel1L-Hrd1 in the progression of B cell development.

The ER-resident ubiquitin-protein ligase complex Sel1L-Hrd1 is the core component of the ER-associated degradation complex (ERAD-C) which is composed of three other components and this makes the ubiquitine-protein ligation highly efficient.
B cells are the largest antibody producing cell and the antibody has to be produced and folded before it can be released from the cell.
If the antibody cannot be folded in the right way then the ERAD system will degrade it and try to make another one.
But we found that the sel1L-Hrd1 complex stops B cells that has a problem making an antibody in the right way from going to the next step in B cell development.

If we were to knock out the Sel1L in the mouse cells that are going to become B cells then we find that the number of B cells that are able to produce their antibody after the B cell has reached its full form increases.
The B cell is full formed when it can get in to the part of the B cell that is called B-1 cell which is B cell in the blood.
And we know that many B cells can not enter B-1 cell.
In fact a lot of B cells die when they go through the part where the B cell becomes full formed.

If we were to knock out the Sel1L in a mouse that will be B cell then we can find that the B cell that will be B cell will be able to get in the B-1 cell and we can see that they are more in number than the ones that had the Sel1L.
